question: Which of the following signaling mediators is NOT involved in the activation of the infocito T ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Lyn kinase -> NOT involved in the activation of the infocito T -> 95% CHAIN: Ras proteins -> involved in the activation of the infocito T -> 90% CHAIN: Kinase regulated by extracellular signals (ERK) -> involved in the activation of the infocito T -> 85% CHAIN: C-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK) -> involved in the activation of the infocito T -> 95%
analysis: In the activation of the T cell receptor (TCR) signaling pathway, Lyn kinase is not directly involved. Lyn kinase is a member of the Src family of kinases and is primarily associated with B cell receptor signaling, not T cell receptor signaling.
